subject.title: feat(subagents): native announceTarget for subagent completion routing (#27445)

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose native subagent completion destination as a per-call and per-agent/global configuration contract, including restart-durable parent-only delivery?
rationale: Code, proof, and Codex-contract review support the mechanism, but accepting new model-facing, operator-configurable, persisted routing policy requires maintainer product and compatibility intent.

options.title: Accept the full contract
options.body: Land the per-call, per-agent, global-default, and persisted parent-routing surfaces with `channel` remaining the compatibility default.

options.title: Narrow to per-call routing
options.body: Keep `sessions_spawn.announceTarget` but remove the two configuration defaults until broader routing policy is explicitly needed.

options.title: Defer native routing
options.body: Pause or close the PR and retain explicit callback workarounds if no agents owner sponsors the permanent contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the full contract
recommendation.body: Land the per-call, per-agent, global-default, and persisted parent-routing surfaces with `channel` remaining the compatibility default.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and carried the central announce delivery state machine and have the strongest history-based ownership signal for this routing-contract decision.
